title: Full-mode evaluation of the 3GPP 256-bit confidentiality and integrity algorithm sets for 6G: code and data
description: Code and raw measurement data for the paper Full-Mode Evaluation of the 3GPP 256-bit Confidentiality and Integrity Algorithm Sets for 6G: Packet Size, Energy and Timing Leakage on Microcontroller, ARM, x86 and FPGA (submitted to the Journal of Cryptographic Engineering). The package implements 256-NEA, 256-NIA and 256-NCA with SNOW 5G, AES-256 and ZUC-256 at several optimization levels and as FPGA designs, measures them on an ESP32, a Raspberry Pi 5, an AMD Zen 4 processor and a Spartan-7 FPGA, and contains every raw result file, the script that rebuilds the merged results and the script that generates the supplementary tables. The 3GPP specifications, their reference code and their test data are not included.
